cards.text: The prophet Zechariah has been seeing visions in the night, with an angel showing him what they mean (Zechariah 1:8-9). Now the angel shows him Joshua the high priest, standing before the angel of the LORD. And standing right at Joshua's right hand, of ALL the people who could be standing there, is Satan.

cards.question: Satan is standing at the right hand of Joshua the high priest to ___ him.
Then the LORD speaks, and He talks straight to Satan. What does He say?

answers.text: You may test him for a time

cards.text: Then the LORD asks about Joshua: "Is not this man a firebrand snatched from the fire?" Not strolled out, not politely escorted, SNATCHED, like me grabbing a tray out of the oven when the timer's been going off for ten minutes.
Now look at Joshua, standing there before the angel. Check out what he's wearing, friend, and take your time with it.

cards.question: Joshua the high priest stands before the angel dressed in filthy garments.
So the angel gives an order to those standing before him about Joshua. What is it?

answers.text: Send him out of the camp
Let him wash in the river

cards.question: Then the angel tells Joshua what taking off those clothes means: his ___ has been removed.
The angel also promises Joshua something new to wear: splendid robes.

cards.text: Zechariah is just watching this vision, and then he jumps right in with a request. That's me when somebody else decorates a batch: "Hold on, hold on. Let me add ONE thing."

cards.question: Zechariah asks them to put a clean ___ on Joshua's head.

cards.text: So a clean turban goes on Joshua's head, and they clothe him while the angel of the LORD stands by. Filthy clothes OUT, clean clothes IN, and friend, the only other makeover I've seen like that was mine, coming out of the back of a junk drawer.

cards.question: Then the angel of the LORD gives Joshua a charge from the LORD of Hosts, and it starts with an "if." What does Joshua have to do?

answers.text: Walk in His ways and keep His instructions
Rebuild the wall around all of Jerusalem
Offer a lamb on the altar every morning

cards.question: If Joshua walks in the LORD's ways and keeps His instructions, he'll govern the LORD's house and have charge of His courts. The LORD also promises him a place among the kings of Judah.

cards.text: Then the LORD speaks to high priest Joshua and his companions seated before him, and He drops BIG news: "For behold, I am going to bring My servant, the Branch." Friend, when God starts a sentence with "behold," you put the cookie down.

cards.question: The LORD says, "Hear now, O high priest Joshua, you and your companions seated before you, who are indeed a ___."

cards.text: Next the LORD points to a stone He has set before Joshua, with seven eyes on that one stone, and says He will engrave an inscription on it. Friend, I stamp cookies for a living, and I have NEVER stamped anything like that.

cards.question: Joshua's iniquity was removed. Now the LORD of Hosts says He will remove the iniquity of this land over seventy years.
After promising to remove the land's iniquity in a single day, the LORD of Hosts says that on that day, "you will each invite your neighbor" to do what?

answers.text: Sit with them under their vine and fig tree
Stand with them on guard at the city wall
Help them rebuild the house of the LORD

cards.text: And that's where we'll leave Zechariah for now. Keep your apron on, friend, because this prophet is not done seeing things yet.
